parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the functionality to receive syslog information on a UDS.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: File path of the Unix Domain Socket. Which MUST use the URI scheme file {{bibref|RFC8089|The file URI Scheme}}. Example: 'file:///tmp/syslog.sock'

object.description: This object describes the configuration parameters for receiving syslog information on a Unix Domain Socket (UDS).
